description: Source file implementing null sink classes for F1-U and F1-C bearers, and their disconnect methods, used in a 3GPP/5G NR context.

classes.name: null_sink_f1c_bearer
classes.description: A null implementation of f1c_bearer that discards PDU handling.

classes.name: null_sink_f1u_bearer
classes.description: A null implementation of f1u_bearer and related handler interfaces, used to discard events.

classes.name: null_sink_rlc_bearer
classes.description: A null implementation of RLC bearer interfaces for discarding SDUs and PDUs.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the respective bearer by connecting to a null sink instance.
